title: Bilateral Germ Cell Tumor of the Testis: Biological and Clinical Implications for a Stem Versus Genetic Origin of Cancers.
title_ja: 精巣両側胚細胞腫瘍：がんの幹細胞由来対遺伝的起源に関する生物学的および臨床的意味
summary_ja: 二側性精巣GCT 38例（9例でゲノム解析）を全エクソーム解析とエピジェネティック解析で評価。セミノーマと非セミノーマは分子的に異なり、二側性腫瘍間での保存された変異は観察されず遺伝的ではなく細胞起源を示唆。
summary_en: This study evaluated 38 bilateral testicular GCT cases (9 with genomic analysis) using whole-exome sequencing and epigenetic analysis. Seminomas and non-seminomas were molecularly distinct. No conserved mutations between bilateral tumors suggested cellular rather than genetic origin.

title: A Case of Mature Cystic Teratoma of the Floor of Mouth With Cleft Palate in Newborn.
title_ja: 口底の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と新生児口蓋裂：症例報告
summary_ja: 口底に伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫および関連する新生児口蓋裂の稀な症例報告。臨床的発現、画像特性、病理学的知見、およびこの稀な新生児頭頸部腫瘍の外科的管理戦略の包括的分析。
summary_en: This case reports a rare mature cystic teratoma of the floor of mouth with associated cleft palate in a newborn. Comprehensive analysis of clinical manifestations, imaging characteristics, pathological findings, and surgical management strategies for this uncommon neonatal head and neck tumor.

title: Bilateral ovarian cystic teratomas with a left Sertoli Leydig cell tumor: A case report.
title_ja: 左Sertoli Leydig cell腫瘍を伴う両側卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 32歳女性の二側性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と左セルトリ・ライディヒ細胞腫瘍の症例。高アンドロゲン血症と無月経で発症。腹腔鏡下腫瘍切除後にテストステロン値が有意に低下。妊孕性温存手術を施行した。
summary_en: This case describes a 32-year-old woman with bilateral mature cystic teratomas and left Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor presenting with hyperandrogenemia and amenorrhea. Laparoscopic tumor resection resulted in significant testosterone decrease. Fertility-sparing surgery was performed.

title: Multidisciplinary management of a neonate with oropharyngeal teratoma and bilateral cleft lip and palate: a rare congenital presentation.
title_ja: 口咽頭奇形腫および両側口唇裂を伴う新生児の多学際的管理：稀な先天性臨床像
summary_ja: 先天性咽頭部奇形腫と両側口唇裂・口蓋裂の稀有な合併例。多臓器協働による早期診断と完全切除が重要。新生児の気道管理と外科的治療戦略を述べている。
summary_en: Case of large congenital oropharyngeal teratoma (germ cell tumor) in neonate with bilateral cleft lip and palate and imperforate anus. Highlights diagnostic and surgical challenges in managing complex craniofacial germ cell tumors. Successful outcome required early diagnosis, multidisciplinary collaboration, and complete surgical excision despite dense adhesions.

title: Bilateral Seminoma in a Pediatric Patient With a History of Cryptorchidism: A Case Report.
title_ja: 停留精巣の既往を有する小児患者における両側セミノーマ：症例報告
summary_ja: 両側停留精巣の既往を有する16歳における極めてまれな両側セミノーマの症例報告。病理学的特徴、治療(両側精巣摘除術)、病期Iの疾患分類について論じている。小児同時性両側胚細胞腫瘍における生殖能温存、ホルモンモニタリング、および長期フォローアップの重要性を強調する。
summary_en: Case report of rare bilateral seminoma in 16-year-old with history of bilateral cryptorchidism. Discusses pathological features, treatment (bilateral orchiectomy), stage I disease classification. Emphasizes importance of fertility preservation, hormonal monitoring, and long-term follow-up in pediatric synchronous bilateral germ cell tumors.

title: Mature cystic teratoma and their malignant transformation.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫とその悪性転化
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（良性胚細胞腫瘍）と潜在的な悪性転化のレビュー。様々な転化タイプの臨床的および生物学的特徴、臨床的行動の差異および治療的アプローチについて論じている。良性と悪性MCTの間で管理戦略が大きく異なることを強調する。
summary_en: Review of mature cystic teratomas (benign germ cell tumors) and their potential malignant transformations. Discusses clinical and biological features of various transformation types, differences in clinical behavior and therapeutic approaches. Emphasizes that management strategies differ significantly between benign and malignant MCT.

title: Very Early Relapse (< 1 year) in de novo Metastatic Seminoma is Associated With Reduced Overall Survival.
title_ja: 初発転移性セミノーマにおける極早期再発(<1年)は全生存期間の低下と関連している
summary_ja: 459例のセミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の後方視的研究において、極早期再発(<12ヶ月)は転移性疾患で高い転移負荷および悪いhCG/LDHレベルと関連し、全生存期間が有意に低下していた。治療医は治療強化の早期検討が必要。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 459 seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor patients assessing very early relapse (VER, <12 months) versus later relapse patterns. VER in metastatic disease associated with higher tumor burden at diagnosis and significantly worse overall survival. Identifies HCG and LDH levels as prognostic markers to guide treatment intensification decisions.

title: Human malignant ovarian germ cell tumor cell lines derived from peritoneal cytology retrieving from circulating tumor cell system.
title_ja: 循環腫瘍細胞システムから得られた腹膜液細胞診由来のヒト悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株
summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍(卵黄嚢腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、未熟奇形腫、混合型腫瘍)から腹膜液細胞診を用いた永続的細胞株の確立技術について述べている。細胞株は免疫蛍光顕微鏡検査およびフロー・サイトメトリーで特性化され、化学療法感受性パターンは臨床反応を反映し、個人化治療を実現する。
summary_en: Describes novel technique for establishing permanent cell lines from malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (yolk sac tumor, dysgerminoma, immature teratoma, mixed tumors) using peritoneal cytology. Cell lines characterized by immunofluorescence and flow cytometry with chemosensitivity patterns reflecting clinical responses, enabling functional studies and personalized treatment approaches.

title: Matching plasma and tissue miRNA expression analysis to detect viable ovarian germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 血漿および組織マイクロRNA(miRNA)発現マッチング解析による生存可能卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の検出
summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者のマイクロRNA(miR-371-3、miR-302/367)バイオマーカー研究。生存可能非奇形腫腫瘍は有意に上昇した血漿および組織マイクロRNAレベルを示し、疾患負荷および治療反応と相関し、臨床管理のための循環バイオマーカー化の可能性を示唆している。
summary_en: Study of microRNA biomarkers (miR-371-3, miR-302/367) in ovarian germ cell tumors comparing viable non-teratoma tumors (VNTGC) and immature teratoma (ITGC). VNTGC showed significantly elevated plasma and tissue miRNA levels, with kinetics correlating to disease burden and treatment response, suggesting potential as circulating biomarkers for clinical management.

title: Between the Devil and the Deep Sea-The Cardiac Conundrum: Report of a Contiguous Cavo-Atrial Tumor Thrombus in NSGCT Testis.
title_ja: 悪魔と深海の間で-心臓の謎：精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における連続下大静脈-心房腫瘍栓の症例報告
summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の大きな傍大静脈リンパ節塊および下大静脈-心房腫瘍栓の症例。体外循環、胸骨切開、血管再建、および完全腫瘍切除を必要とする複雑な外科的管理について記述。多面的画像診断と外科的専門技術の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: Case report of metastatic non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor with large paracaval lymph node mass and contiguous cavo-atrial thrombus extending to right atrium. Describes complex surgical management requiring cardiopulmonary bypass, vascular reconstruction, and complete tumor resection emphasizing importance of multimodal imaging and surgical expertise.

title: High-Grade Immature Gastric Teratoma in a 10-Day-Old Neonate: Diagnostic Challenges and Curative Surgical Management.
title_ja: 生後10日の新生児における高度未熟胃奇形腫：診断的課題と治療的外科的管理
summary_ja: 生後10日の新生児に発症した極めてまれな高度未熟胃奇形腫（胚細胞腫瘍）の症例であり、緊急手術が必要であった。出生時に血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が著しく上昇していた。部分胃切除術による外科的切除は密な癒着にもかかわらず完全な縁辺を達成した。病理組織学的検査は悪性胚細胞成分を伴わないIII度未熟奇形腫を確認した。
summary_en: Case of rare high-grade immature gastric teratoma (germ cell tumor) in 10-day-old neonate requiring emergent surgery. Markedly elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) at birth. Surgical resection with partial gastrectomy achieved complete margins despite dense adhesions. Histopathology confirmed grade III immature teratoma without malignant germ cell components.

title: 45-Year-old with testicular mixed germ-cell tumor associated with massive hydrocele and a misleading CT scan showing bilateral testicles involvement: A case report.
title_ja: 大量陰嚢水腫を伴い、両側精巣浸潤を示唆するCT所見を伴う精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍：45歳患者症例報告
summary_ja: 大量陰嚢水腫と上昇したAFPを伴う精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍患者(45歳)。CT検査は両側精巣病変を示唆したが、術中所見と腫瘍マーカーにより単側病変と判明。診断における画像検査、病理組織学、および臨床判断の統合の重要性を示しています。
summary_en: Case report of testicular mixed germ cell tumor (TMGCT) with seminoma component in 45-year-old with massive hydrocele and elevated AFP. CT imaging suggested bilateral disease but intraoperative findings and tumor markers led to appropriate histological interpretation. Demonstrates importance of integrating clinical judgment, intraoperative assessment, and tumor markers for accurate diagnosis.

title: Squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma of the ovary in a premenopausal women: A rare case report.
title_ja: 閉経前女性における卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からの扁平上皮癌：稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 25歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からの扁平上皮癌の悪性転化症例。腹痛と体重減少で発症。病期分類開腹術で左卵巣腫瘤と腹水を確認。外科的切除と化学療法を施行しましたが、フォローアップの継続が困難で、遠隔地での治療継続の課題を示しています。
summary_en: Case of malignant transformation of ovarian mature cystic teratoma (germ cell tumor) to squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) in 25-year-old woman. Presents with abdominal pain and weight loss. Staging laparotomy and surgical resection performed. Case highlights rarity of malignant transformation in younger women and challenges of surveillance maintenance, emphasizing importance of follow-up compliance.

title: Muscle weakness with a hidden cause.
title_ja: 原因不明の筋力低下
summary_ja: 皮膚筋炎として発症した精巣セミノーマの傍腫瘍症候群症例。患者は進行性近位筋弱力、高度なCK上昇、特徴的な皮膚所見を呈しました。包括的な悪性腫瘍検索でセミノーマが発見されました。傍腫瘍症候群としての皮膚筋炎の稀有性と悪性腫瘍検索の重要性を示しています。
summary_en: Case report of dermatomyositis (DM) as paraneoplastic manifestation of pure seminoma (testicular germ cell tumor). Patient presented with progressive proximal muscle weakness, elevated creatine kinase, and characteristic skin/periungual features. Underlying seminoma discovered during comprehensive malignancy workup. Case underscores importance of malignancy screening in paraneoplastic syndromes.

title: Key Updates in Testicular Cancer: Optimizing Survivorship and Survival.
title_ja: 精巣がんの主要な最新知見：生存者支援と生存予後の最適化
journal: Am Soc Clin Oncol Educ Book
summary_ja: 精巣がん(主に胚細胞腫瘍)の多重療法、シスプラチン併用化学療法による優れた成績と、長期生存者の長期的健康障害を包括的にレビュー。内分泌機能障害、心血管疾患、二次悪性腫瘍、神経障害などの合併症、病期IIセミノーマなどの治療縮小戦略を討議。学際的アプローチによる生活の質向上を強調しました。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of testicular cancer (predominantly germ cell tumors) advances in multimodal therapy, cisplatin-based chemotherapy outcomes, and long-term survivorship issues. Discusses treatment-related complications (endocrine dysfunction, cardiovascular disease, secondary malignancies, neuropathy), de-escalation strategies for stage II seminoma, and multidisciplinary approach to optimize quality of life.

title: Clinical routine care for choriocarcinoma: a descriptive analysis of data from the Baden-Wuerttemberg Cancer Registry (BWCR).
title_ja: 絨毛癌の臨床通常治療：Baden-Wuerttemberg癌登録（BWCR）データの記述的分析
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の臨床管理と予後に関する集団ベース研究。MTX、EMA-CO治療の実臨床パターンと治療抵抗例を報告。
summary_en: Population-based registry analysis of 38 gestational choriocarcinoma patients in Germany (2015-2023). Documents real-world treatment patterns (MTX, EMA-CO regimens), outcomes, and adverse events. Reports treatment resistance in some cases requiring escalation. Emphasizes importance of individualized treatment and close monitoring for optimal management of this rare gestational trophoblastic disease.

title: Multiomics Approach Distinguishes SPTBN4 as a Key Molecule in Diagnosis, Prognosis, and Immune Suppression of Testicular Seminomas.
title_ja: マルチオミクスアプローチによる精巣セミノーマの診断、予後および免疫抑制におけるSPTBN4の主要分子としての同定
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマのマルチオミクス解析。SPTBN4が診断、予後、免疫抑制に関連する重要な分子バイオマーカーとして同定。化学療法感受性と関連。
summary_en: Multiomics study of testicular seminomas using single-cell RNA sequencing and weighted gene coexpression analysis. Identifies SPTBN4 as key biomarker associated with advanced disease, immunosuppressive microenvironment, and poor prognosis. Demonstrates increased chemotherapy sensitivity in SPTBN4-high tumors, providing potential therapeutic guidance and precision medicine strategy for seminoma management.

title: A rare case of malignant transformation: squamous cell carcinoma arising on the basis of an ovarian mature cystic teratoma.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌：悪性転化の稀な症例
summary_ja: 27歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からの扁平上皮癌の悪性転化症例。術中凍結切片では成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断されたが、確定診断で扁平上皮癌と判明。凍結切片分析の限界と包括的評価の重要性を示しています。
summary_en: Case of malignant transformation of ovarian mature cystic teratoma (germ cell tumor) to squamous cell carcinoma in 27-year-old woman with chronic abdominal pain. Imaging suggested MCT with malignancy features but intraoperative frozen section initially misread as MCT. Definitive histopathology confirmed SCC, highlighting limitations of frozen section and need for comprehensive evaluation.

title: Estrogen-secreting testicular tumors in 46,XY female patients with 17α-hydroxylase/17,20-lyase deficiency: two unusual case reports and a review of the literature.
title_ja: 17α-ヒドロキシラーゼ/17,20-リアーゼ欠損患者のエストロゲン分泌精巣腫瘍：2例の症例報告と文献考察
summary_ja: 17α-ヒドロキシラーゼ/17,20-リアーゼ欠損症の46,XY女性患者における精巣腫瘍(セミノーマおよび精巣内癌)の2例報告。CYP17A1病原性バリアントを同定。46,XY患者における悪性腫瘍危険性を強調し、予防的去勢の危険性と利益について検討しました。
summary_en: Two case reports of 46,XY female patients with 17α-hydroxylase/17,20-lyase deficiency who developed testicular tumors including seminoma and germ cell neoplasia in situ. Emphasizes increased malignant tumor risk in 46,XY patients with this endocrine condition, adding evidence to risk/benefit discussion of prophylactic gonadectomy. Pathogenic CYP17A1 variants identified.

title: Pediatric Head and Neck Germ Cell Tumors: Current Management and Risk of Malignant Transformation.
title_ja: 小児頭頸部胚細胞腫瘍:現在の管理と悪性転化のリスク
summary_ja: フランスの152人の小児頭頸部胚細胞腫瘍患者(出生～17歳)を対象とした多施設後方視的研究。150例は成熟/未熟奇形腫、2例は悪性卵黄嚢腫瘍。悪性転化率は低く(1.3%)、新生児例では定期的臨床診察のみで長期腫瘍学的監視は不要。
summary_en: Multicenter retrospective study of 152 pediatric head and neck germ cell tumor patients (birth-17 years) in France 2000-2021. Most (150/152) contained mature or immature teratoma; two were malignant yolk sac tumors. Surgery was primary treatment. Low malignant degeneration rate (1.3%) and excellent survival suggest conservative follow-up without systematic oncologic monitoring for neonatal MIT HN-GCT.

title: Olanzapine combined with standard antiemetics for the prevention of nausea and vomiting in patients with germ cell tumor undergoing a 5-day cisplatin-based chemotherapy (NAVIGATE study)： A phase III crossover trial.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者における5日間シスプラチン併用化学療法時の悪心・嘔吐予防のためのオランザピンと標準制吐薬の併用（NAVIGATE研究）：第III相クロスオーバー試験
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者にシスプラチン化学療法中の悪心・嘔吐予防にオランザピンを追加する第III相試験。オランザピン群で完全奏効率が有意に高く（55.8% vs 36.3%）、毒性増加なし。
summary_en: Phase III trial evaluating olanzapine combined with triple antiemetic therapy for chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting in 77 germ cell tumor patients receiving 5-day cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Olanzapine group showed significantly higher complete response rates (55.8% vs 36.3%, P=0.03) with no increased toxicity.

title: Case Report: Multidisciplinary discussion and management of a case involving a non-seminomatous germ cell tumor complicated by the presence of cancerous thrombus in the inferior vena cava.
title_ja: 症例報告：下大静脈腫瘍栓を合併した非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍症例の多科的討議と治療
summary_ja: 病期IIICの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で、肺、腎臓、リンパ節への転移を伴い、下大静脈腫瘍栓が合併した症例を報告しました。多科的チームによる討議のもと、手術と補助化学療法を含む治療を行い、良好な治療転帰を得られました。
summary_en: Case report of stage IIIC mixed non-seminomatous germ cell tumor with metastases to lungs, kidney, and lymph nodes, complicated by inferior vena cava tumor thrombus. Multidisciplinary management including surgery and chemotherapy resulted in optimal therapeutic outcomes.

title: Robotic retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection for testicular cancer: initial experience.
title_ja: 精巣がんに対するロボット支援下後腹膜リンパ節郭清：初期経験
summary_ja: 精巣がんに対するロボット支援下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の初期イギリス経験。対象は24患者で大多数が化学療法後でした。平均コンソール時間171分、出血量190mlの安全な手術でした。最も一般的な病理所見は奇形腫(70%)で、腫瘍学的転帰は良好でした。
summary_en: First UK case series of 24 robotic-assisted retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer, mostly post-chemotherapy. Safe procedure with mean console time 171 min and blood loss 190 ml. Most common pathology was teratoma (70%) with favorable oncological outcomes.

title: Long-term survival and prognostic factors in extragonadal germ cell tumors: a 30-year experience at a single institution.
title_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍における長期生存と予後因子：単一施設での30年の経験
summary_ja: 精巣外胚細胞腫瘍31例の30年間の長期転帰。縦隔が59%で最多。化学療法後の奏効率81%、5・10年生存率70%。縦隔NSGCTの予後が最悪。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 31 extragonadal germ cell tumor patients from 1994-2024. Most common sites: mediastinum (59%), retroperitoneum, and CNS. After chemotherapy, disease control rate was 81%. 5- and 10-year overall survival were 70%, with mediastinal NSGCT showing worst prognosis (34%).

title: Ovarian Tumors during Pregnancy and Adverse Pregnancy Outcome: A Retrospective Analysis.
title_ja: 妊娠中の卵巣腫瘍と妊娠転帰不良：後方視的分析
summary_ja: 妊娠中の卵巣腫瘍190例。胚細胞腫瘍が50.79%、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が98%を占める。第2-3四半期の手術で18.75%が流産。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 190 ovarian tumors during pregnancy among 41,842 pregnant women (4.5 per 1,000 pregnancies). Germ cell tumors comprised 50.79% of surgical cases, with mature cystic teratoma in 98%. Most surgeries in 2nd-3rd trimester with 18.75% fetal loss rate.

title: Mucinous neoplasms associated with mature cystic teratomas: A clinicopathologic study of 50 cases: Are we ready for nomenclature change?
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に関連した粘液性腫瘍：50例の臨床病理学的研究―命名法変更の準備はできているか？
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に関連した粘液性腫瘍50例の臨床病理学的研究。ほとんどはミューラー管/体腔上皮型でFIGO病期Iでした。粘液性癌は最も悪い転帰を示し、死亡3例と再発4例が報告されました。
summary_en: Clinicopathologic study of 50 mucinous neoplasms associated with ovarian mature cystic teratomas. Most were Müllerian/surface epithelial type (82%) and FIGO stage I. Mucinous carcinomas had worst outcomes with 3 deaths and 4 recurrences.

title: Potential Role of PTEN and AKT/PKB Proteins in the Pathogenesis of Ovarian Mature Teratomas.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫の発症機序におけるPTENおよびAKT/PKBタンパク質の潜在的役割
summary_ja: 117例の卵巣成熟奇形腫のPTENとリン酸化AKT発現の検討。PI3K/AKT経路の異常が発生に関与している可能性が示唆される。
summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of PTEN and phosphorylated AKT expression in 117 mature ovarian teratomas. Elevated P-AKT and altered PTEN expression suggest involvement of PI3K/AKT pathway in teratoma pathogenesis, supporting role of signaling abnormalities in tumor development.

title: Cystic teratoma of the head and neck region in the neonate - description of three cases.
title_ja: 新生児における頭頸部領域の嚢胞性奇形腫―3症例の記述
summary_ja: 分娩後に新生児男性患者で診断された頭頸部領域の先天性成熟奇形腫3症例。全例がGonzalez-Crussi分類G0。鼻咽頭部位の奇形腫は外科的切除が第一選択。画像検査と検査室検査を含む長期フォローアップが必要。
summary_en: Three cases of congenital head and neck mature teratomas diagnosed post-birth in newborn males. All classified as G0 (Gonzalez-Crussi grade 0). Nasopharyngeal-located teratomas required surgical resection as first-line treatment with long-term follow-up.

title: Maternal Uniparental Isodisomy of Chromosome 6: A Novel Case of Teratoma and Autism Spectrum Disorder with a Diagnostic and Management Framework.
title_ja: 染色体6の母性単親性等二染色体：自閉症スペクトラム障害と奇形腫の新規症例と診断・管理フレームワーク
summary_ja: 母親由来第6染色体一親性ダイソミーの患者の仙尾部奇形腫。宮内発育不全、発達遅滞、自閉症スペクトラム障害を呈示。24例の既報例の文献検討。
summary_en: Case report of sacrococcygeal teratoma in female with maternal uniparental isodisomy of chromosome 6, presenting with intrauterine growth restriction, developmental delay, autism spectrum disorder, and dysmorphic features. Literature review of 24 confirmed UPD(6)mat cases identified frequent IUGR and neurodevelopmental issues.

title: Fertility-preserving approach in growing teratoma syndrome with repeated ovarian surgeries.
title_ja: 反復卵巣手術を伴うgrowing teratoma syndromeにおける妊孕性温存アプローチ
summary_ja: 左未熟卵巣奇形腫（病期IC1）と診断された21歳女性の症例。妊孕性温存のため両側卵巣嚢腫切除術と化学療法を施行。その後growing teratoma syndromeで反復手術が必要。補助生殖技術で妊娠成功し、健康な男児を分娩。
summary_en: Case report of 21-year-old with left immature ovarian teratoma (stage IC1) treated with cystectomy and chemotherapy for fertility preservation. Developed growing teratoma syndrome with repeated ovarian surgeries. Assisted reproduction resulted in successful healthy male delivery.

title: Changes in local mineral homeostasis facilitate the formation of benign and malignant testicular microcalcifications.
title_ja: 局所ミネラルホメオスターシスの変化が良性および悪性精巣微細石灰化の形成を促進する
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に伴う微小石灰化の形成メカニズム。FGF23の異常な切断が関与。ミネラルホメオスタシスの局所的異常が骨様分化を誘導。
summary_en: Study of testicular microcalcifications in germ cell tumor development. FGF23 expressed in testicular germ cell neoplasia in situ and embryonal carcinoma undergoes aberrant cleavage. Local mineral homeostasis dysregulation and reduced mineralization inhibitors lead to osteogenic differentiation and hydroxyapatite deposition.

title: Mediastinal NUT Carcinoma With Raised Serum Alpha-Fetoprotein Mimicking a Malignant Germ Cell Tumor: Suspicion Raised Due to Negative Serum miR-371a-3p Levels.
title_ja: 血清αフェトプロテイン上昇を伴う縦隔NUT癌：血清miR-371a-3p陰性により疑われた悪性胚細胞腫瘍の模倣
summary_ja: AFP高値の縦隔NUT癌がGCTを模倣した症例。血清miR-371a-3p陰性で診断疑い。全ゲノムシーケンシングでBRD4::NUTM1融合を確認。分子診断の有用性を示示。
summary_en: Case of mediastinal NUT carcinoma mimicking malignant non-seminomatous GCT due to elevated serum AFP and metastases. Serum miR-371a-3p negativity raised diagnostic suspicion. Whole genome sequencing identified BRD4::NUTM1 fusion, demonstrating importance of molecular testing.

title: The Importance of Follow-Up in Adolescent Patients With a History of Ovarian Dermoid Cysts: A Case Report.
title_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の既往歴がある思春期患者におけるフォローアップの重要性：症例報告
summary_ja: 精神症状をきっかけに両側成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された12歳の症例報告。初期腹腔鏡下卵巣温存切除と1年後の再発に対する処置の後、フォローアップが途絶。複数再発で20歳時に両側卵管卵巣摘除術が必要になり早発閉経。思春期患者における定期的フォローアップの重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case of 12-year-old with bilateral mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts) presenting with paraneoplastic encephalitis. After initial laparoscopic resection and recurrence management, developed multiple recurrences requiring bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy at age 20, resulting in premature menopause.

title: Male choriocarcinoma presenting with intracerebral hemorrhage: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 脳出血で発症した男性絨毛癌：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 精巣原発絨毛癌の脳転移による脳内出血症例。脳転移で初発。精巣原発絨毛癌の稀な発症と転移特性について文献考察を施行。
summary_en: Case of 65-year-old with testicular choriocarcinoma presenting with intracerebral hemorrhage from brain metastases. Literature review of male choriocarcinoma cases. Discusses characteristics of hidden onset, easy invasion and metastasis, with most cases having distant metastases at diagnosis.

title: Malignant germ cells tumor of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 卵巣癌の約5％を占める悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の総合的なレビュー。若い女性が主な対象で、ディスジャーミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、未熟奇形腫を含む。妊孕性温存手術、プラチナベース化学療法、新興標的療法について論じ、長期フォローアップと分子理解の必要性を強調。
summary_en: Review of malignant ovarian germ cell tumors accounting for ~5% of ovarian cancers, primarily in young women. Covers dysgerminomas, yolk sac tumors, immature teratomas with discussion of fertility-sparing surgery, platinum-based chemotherapy, and emerging targeted therapies.

title: Calcified and Impacted Cervical Fibroid in a Young Female in a Low-resource Setting Mistaken for Bladder Mass: Case Report and Literature Review.
title_ja: 限定的なリソースを有する設定において膀胱腫瘤と誤認された石灰化および嵌頓性子宮頸部筋腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 超音波検査で膀胱腫瘤と誤認された石灰化子宮頸部筋腫と偶発的な成熟卵巣奇形腫の症例。26歳女性が下腹部腫脹、尿閉、排尿困難を呈示。開腹手術で左卵巣腫瘤と巨大な石灰化骨盤腫瘤を確認。組織診で成熟卵巣奇形腫と筋腫と診断。
summary_en: Case of 26-year-old with calcified cervical fibroid and incidental mature ovarian teratoma initially mistaken for bladder mass on ultrasound. Laparotomy revealed left ovarian mass and huge calcified pelvic mass. Histology confirmed mature ovarian teratoma and cervical fibroid.

title: A case report of NMDAR encephalopathy - A neurologic condition that a gynecologist can cure.
title_ja: NMDAR脳炎の症例報告—婦人科医が治療できる神経疾患
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に関連するNMDAR脳炎の症例報告。抗精神病薬治療に反応しなかった急性精神病患者がMRIで卵巣奇形腫を診断され、腹腔鏡下卵巣摘出術により症状が著明に改善した。本症例は奇形腫摘出がこの自己免疫疾患の治療に重要であることを示している。
summary_en: Anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma in a young woman presenting with acute psychosis, catatonia, and mania. MRI identified a benign ovarian teratoma not detected on ultrasound. Complete symptom resolution occurred following laparoscopic left oophorectomy, demonstrating the critical role of gynecologic intervention in treating this autoimmune neurological condition.

title: Modeling of cancer stem cells and the tumor microenvironment Via NT2/D1 cells to probe pathology and treatment for cancer and beyond.
title_ja: NT2/D1細胞による癌幹細胞と腫瘍微小環境のモデル化：癌および中枢神経系疾患の病理と治療の解析
summary_ja: 人間の胚性癌に由来するNT2/D1細胞は、がん幹細胞と腫瘍微小環境の相互作用をモデル化するために使用される。この総説では、GCT病態生理に重要なCSCとTME特性を検討し、GCT生物学の理解に有用なモデルとして確立している。
summary_en: NT2/D1 cells derived from human embryonal carcinoma serve as a biological model for studying cancer stem cells and tumor microenvironment interactions. Review examines CSC and TME characteristics in embryonal carcinoma cells relevant to understanding GCT pathology and developing targeted therapeutics.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma - prognosis based on prenatal ultrasound diagnosis, single-center experience and literature review.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫―出生前超音波検査診断に基づく予後、単一施設の経験と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 最も一般的な先天性腫瘍である仙尾部奇形腫の16例後方視的研究。嚢胞性腫瘍形態と胎児心不全の兆候がないことが良好な転帰を予測。早期外科的切除による低い合併症発生率。詳細な出生前超音波が最適な予後評価に不可欠で出生前カウンセリングに有用。
summary_en: Sacrococcygeal teratoma is the most common congenital tumor with variable malignant potential. Retrospective study of 16 cases showed that cystic tumor morphology and absence of fetal cardiac failure predicted favorable outcomes. Early surgical resection resulted in low complication rates, with detailed prenatal ultrasound essential for optimal prognostic assessment.

title: Single-cell profiling in ovarian germ cell and sex cord-stromal tumours.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍および性索間質腫瘍における単一細胞プロファイリング
summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の単一細胞解析。ジスジェルミノーマは免疫活性化型、不成熟奇形腫は免疫砂漠型、顆粒膜細胞腫瘍は免疫抑制型の異なった微小環境を示した。腫瘍サブタイプ別の免疫療法応答性の差を説明する知見である。
summary_en: Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis revealed distinct tumor microenvironments in ovarian germ cell tumors. Dysgerminomas showed immune activation with exhausted PD-1+ T cells. Immature teratomas displayed immune-desert phenotype with minimal immune infiltration. Granulosa cell tumors exhibited immunosuppressive microenvironment with limited T cell expansion, explaining differential immunotherapy responses.

title: Prognostic Value of Antenatal Tumor Growth Rate Parameters in Fetal Sacrococcygeal Teratoma: A French Multicenter Retrospective Study.
title_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫における出生前腫瘍増殖速度パラメータの予後値：フランス多施設後方視的研究
summary_ja: フランスの多施設研究で28例の胎児仙尾部奇形腫において、腫瘍体積増殖速度が不良な周産期転帰と有意に関連。増殖速度が18.01cm³/週を超え、体積が245cm³を超えた場合、胎児死亡または輸血が必要。増殖動態は出生前カウンセリングの重要な予後情報を提供。
summary_en: Tumor volume growth rate in fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma was significantly associated with poor perinatal outcomes in multicenter French study of 28 cases. Growth rate exceeding 18.01 cm³/week and volume exceeding 245 cm³ predicted fetal death or need for transfusions. Growth kinetics provide important prognostic information for prenatal counseling.

title: Matched-pair analysis of peri-operative and oncological outcomes of robot-assisted vs open retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.
title_ja: ロボット支援対開放後腹膜リンパ節郭清の周術期および腫瘍学的成績のマッチドペア分析
summary_ja: 睾丸胚細胞腫瘍患者の100例を含む後腹膜リンパ節郭清術の比較研究。ロボット支援と開放手術の間で無再発生存率と再発率が同等であり、ロボット支援法が入院期間短縮と低侵襲性の利点を示した。
summary_en: Matched-pair analysis comparing robot-assisted and open retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) in 100 testicular germ cell tumor patients. Both approaches achieved similar progression-free survival and relapse rates. Robot-assisted RPLND offered advantages of shorter hospital stay and reduced morbidity while maintaining comparable oncologic outcomes.

title: Metabolic Syndrome Among Testicular Cancer Survivors: Long-Term Follow-Up of the Veterans Affairs Health System.
title_ja: 精巣がん生存者における代謝症候群：退役軍人保健制度の長期フォローアップ
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍生存者2021人と照合したコントロール7595人の長期フォローアップ研究。精巣がん生存者は5年で17.0％、10年で27.8％の代謝症候群累積発生率を示し、コントロール（1.9％、2.8％）と比較して有意に高かった。化学療法と年齢が独立したリスク因子。代謝健康監視の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Long-term follow-up study of 2021 testicular germ cell tumor survivors versus 7595 matched controls. TC survivors showed significantly higher cumulative incidence of metabolic syndrome: 17.0% at 5 years and 27.8% at 10 years compared to controls (1.9% and 2.8%). Chemotherapy and age were independent risk factors. Study emphasizes importance of metabolic health monitoring.

title: Ovotesticular disorders of sex development with dysgerminoma in a 46, XX/46, XY female: A case report.
title_ja: 46,XX/46,XY女性における卵巣精巣二重性性分化異常と未分化胚細胞腫を伴う症例報告
summary_ja: キメラ核型46,XX/46,XYの両性具有にジスジェルミノーマ（卵巣胚細胞腫瘍）が合併した稀な症例。24歳女性がクリトリス肥大で来院し、右卵巣のジスジェルミノーマが確認され、右卵巣摘出術が行われた。成人の両性具有に胚細胞腫瘍が合併する稀有な症例である。
summary_en: Ovotesticular disorder of sex development with chimeric karyotype (46,XX/46,XY) complicated by dysgerminoma. 24-year-old patient presented with clitoral hypertrophy; histology confirmed dysgerminoma in right ovary. Right oophorectomy and external genitalia reconstruction performed. Case demonstrates rarity of adult ovotesticular DSD with germ cell tumor malignancy.

title: Surgical outcomes in mediastinal mature teratoma.
title_ja: 縦隔成熟奇形腫の外科的転帰
summary_ja: 10年間の縦隔成熟奇形腫35例の外科的転帰。完全外科的切除が主要な治療法。最も一般的な術後合併症は延長した空気漏出（14.3％）。破裂奇形腫は術後合併症の強い予測因子。腫瘍サイズ、位置、周囲構造を考慮したテーラーメイドアプローチの重要性を実証。
summary_en: Surgical outcomes in 35 mediastinal mature teratoma cases over 10 years. Complete surgical resection remains primary curative treatment. Most common postoperative complication was prolonged air leak (14.3%); ruptured teratoma strongly predicted complications. Study demonstrates importance of tailored surgical approach considering tumor size, location, and adjacent structures.

title: Metastasectomy in Thymic and Germ Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 胸腺および胚細胞腫瘍の転移巣摘除術
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の肺転移に対する外科的切除術のレビュー。肺転移切除術がGCT患者の長期生存利益をもたらすことが示されており、化学放射線療法と多学科的評価による管理が推奨されている。
summary_en: Review of pulmonary metastasectomy in germ cell and thymic tumors. Evidence demonstrates long-term survival benefit with pulmonary metastasectomy in GCT patients. Surgical management of thoracic GCT recurrence combined with chemoradiation therapy and multidisciplinary assessment generally recommended for optimal outcomes.

title: Phosphoribosyl transferase domain containing 1: A prognostic biomarker in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: ホスホリボシル転移酵素ドメイン含有1：精巣胚細胞腫瘍における予後バイオマーカー
summary_ja: 457例の睾丸胚細胞腫瘍を含む多施設研究でPRTFDC1が独立した予後予測バイオマーカーとして特定された。PRTFDC1高発現は不良予後を予測し、免疫関連経路を抑制し、CD8+ T細胞浸潤低下と免疫療法応答低下と関連している。
summary_en: PRTFDC1 identified as independent prognostic biomarker in testicular germ cell tumors across 457 TGCT samples. High PRTFDC1 expression predicts poor prognosis, suppresses immune pathways, and associates with low CD8+ T cell infiltration and reduced immunotherapy response. PRTFDC1 may serve as reliable predictor of TGCT prognosis and immunotherapy outcomes.

title: Efficacy and safety of modified bleomycin administration with EP chemotherapy in adult male patients with germ cell tumors: a retrospective study.
title_ja: 成人男性胚細胞腫瘍患者に対する改変ブレオマイシン併用EP化学療法の有効性と安全性:後方視的研究
summary_ja: 274人の成人男性胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした改変-BEP化学療法(3週ごと、ブレオマイシン30 IU)の後方視的研究。治癒的設定での5年無増悪生存期間79.33%、全生存期間86.26%。良好リスク99.05%、中間92.84%、不良55.96%。標準的なBEP療法と比較して利便性が向上している。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 274 adult male GCT patients treated with modified-BEP chemotherapy (tri-weekly 30 IU bleomycin days 1, 3, 5 with etoposide and cisplatin). Curative setting achieved 5-year PFS rate 79.33% and OS rate 86.26%. Stratified outcomes: good-risk 99.05% OS, intermediate 92.84%, poor 55.96%. Study demonstrates efficacy and improved convenience.

title: A complicated case of refractory multiple drug-resistant peritoneal dialysis-associated peritonitis due to teratoma.
title_ja: 奇形腫による難治性多剤耐性腹膜透析関連腹膜炎の複雑な症例
summary_ja: 多剤耐性菌による腹膜透析関連腹膜炎が腹腔内奇形腫に由来する症例報告。抗菌薬治療に反応せず、腹腔内探査で奇形腫が発見され、摘出後に症状が改善。本症例は難治性腹膜炎の原因として奇形腫を考慮する重要性を示している。
summary_en: Case of peritoneal dialysis-associated peritonitis with multidrug-resistant organisms complicated by occult intra-abdominal teratoma. Despite initial antimicrobial therapy, peritonitis proved refractory until teratoma identified on exploration. Following adequate drainage, antibiotic therapy, and teratoma excision, patient successfully transitioned to hemodialysis.

title: Metastatic seminoma from an undescended intra-abdominal testis: Case report and review of management.
title_ja: 停留精巣からの転移性セミノーマ：症例報告と管理の見直し
summary_ja: 44歳患者の停留腹腔内精巣から発生した転移性セミノーマ症例。停留精巣と胚細胞腫瘍発症の強い関連性を示す。除精巣術後BEP化学療法で完全寛解達成。18ヶ月フォローアップで再発なし。早期発見の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Metastatic seminoma from undescended intra-abdominal testis in 44-year-old patient. Case demonstrates strong link between cryptorchidism and testicular germ cell tumor development. Treatment with orchidectomy followed by BEP chemotherapy achieved complete remission with no recurrence at 18-month follow-up. Case emphasizes importance of early detection in cryptorchid patients.

title: Partial sacrectomy with en bloc tumor resection without instrumentation. What level is safe?
title_ja: インスツルメンテーションなしでの部分仙骨切除と一塊腫瘍切除：安全なレベルはどこか？
summary_ja: 仙骨腫瘍に対する部分仙骨切除術の外科成績。対象にはコルドーマ8例、MPNST 4例、卵黄嚢腫瘍2例（胚細胞腫瘍）が含まれた。器械固定なしの部分切除でも選択症例で十分な安定性が得られることが示されている。若年活動的患者では固定が推奨される。
summary_en: Surgical outcomes of partial sacrectomy for 25 patients with various tumors: 8 chordomas, 4 MPNSTs, 2 yolk sac tumors, 2 undifferentiated sarcomas. Study demonstrates that non-instrumented partial sacrectomy provides sufficient stability in selected cases. Instrumentation primarily indicated in younger, more active patients. Yolk sac tumors are germ cell malignancies among indications.

title: Chromosome-specific aberrations, rather than general aneuploidy, may drive mouse embryonic stem cell-derived teratoma metastasis.
title_ja: マウス胚性幹細胞由来奇形腫の転移は一般的な異数性ではなく染色体特異的異常に駆動される可能性がある
summary_ja: マウス胚性幹細胞由来奇形腫の転移メカニズムを検討する研究。一般的な異数性よりも特定の染色体の三倍体(特に6、8、11番)が転移を駆動する可能性を提案。ヒト胚細胞腫瘍における12番染色体三倍体との類似性を指摘し、胚細胞腫瘍研究および治療における臨床的関連性と実験モデルの意義を強調。
summary_en: Study examining chromosome-specific trisomies in mouse ESC-derived teratomas and their parallels with human germ cell tumors. Highlights that chromosome 12 trisomies in malignant human GCTs match those in aneuploid mESCs, suggesting common selection mechanisms underlying metastatic potential and clinical relevance for GCT research.

title: Delayed presentation of mature teratoma with umbilical perforation in a 9-years old female without congenital abdominal wall defects: A rare case report of atypical teratoma location.
title_ja: 先天性腹壁欠損を有しない9歳女児における臍部穿孔を伴う成熟奇形腫の遅延発症:非定型局在の稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 9歳女児に発症した臍部穿孔を伴う成熟奇形腫の稀な症例。造影コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)検査で境界が明確で異質性の腫瘤と石灰化が確認され、完全な外科的切除が実施された。病理組織学的検査で成熟奇形腫が確認され、1年間のフォローアップで再発を認めなかった。
summary_en: Case report of 9-year-old with mature teratoma at unusual umbilical site presenting with progressive enlargement and perforation. Imaging revealed well-encapsulated heterogeneous mass; complete surgical excision confirmed histologically as mature teratoma with no recurrence during 1-year follow-up.

title: Growing teratoma syndrome with extra pelvic metastasis and gliomatosis peritonei.
title_ja: 骨盤外転移と腹膜神経膠腫症を伴う growing teratoma syndrome
summary_ja: 未熟奇形腫に対する補助化学療法後に成熟奇形腫が出現する growing teratoma syndrome 症例。腹膜神経膠腫症も同時に認められた。骨盤外転移も伴い、未熟奇形腫治療後の包括的な画像検査が重要。
summary_en: Case of growing teratoma syndrome with extrapelvic metastasis and gliomatosis peritonei. Condition occurs when mature teratomas develop in patients previously treated with chemotherapy for immature teratoma. Emphasizes importance of comprehensive imaging surveillance after immature teratoma treatment.

title: Central Nervous System Metastases in Endometrial Carcinoma: A Case Series.
title_ja: 子宮内膜癌における中枢神経系転移:症例集積
summary_ja: 子宮内膜悪性腫瘍のCNS転移に関する症例報告。1症例は子宮内膜yolk sac tumor（germ cell tumor）で、初診から数年後に脳転移を発症。子宮内膜がん患者が神経症状を発症した際のニューロイメージングの重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case series of CNS metastases in endometrial malignancies. One case features endometrial yolk sac tumor (a germ cell tumor) presenting with brain metastases years after primary diagnosis. Emphasizes importance of neuroimaging when endometrial cancer patients develop neurologic symptoms.

title: Pseudo-Meigs syndrome: a rare cause of abdominal ascites in a patient with an ovarian mass.
title_ja: 卵巣腫瘤を有する患者における腹部腹水の稀な原因：偽Meigs症候群
summary_ja: 良性卵巣奇形腫に伴う偽Meigs症候群の症例報告。腹水と胸膜液を呈し転移性卵巣癌との鑑別が必要。手術による腫瘍摘出で症状完全寛解。卵巣腫瘤の鑑別診断に重要。
summary_en: Case report of pseudo-Meigs syndrome presenting with ascites and benign ovarian teratoma. Condition mimics metastatic cancer but resolves following surgical removal of the germ cell tumor, illustrating importance of differential diagnosis in ovarian masses.

title: A Case of Primary Extragonadal Germ Cell Malignancy With Testicular Microlithiasis: Its Association and Significance.
title_ja: 精巣微小石灰化を伴う一次性性腺外胚細胞悪性腫瘍：その関連性と臨床的意義
summary_ja: 30歳南アジア系男性の前縦隔一次性性腺外セミノーマ症例。上大静脈症候群で発症。精巣超音波検査で微小石灰化のみ認められた。シスプラチン併用化学療法で症状改善。精巣微小石灰化と性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の関連性について述べた。
summary_en: Case of 30-year-old with primary extragonadal seminoma in anterior mediastinum causing superior vena cava obstruction. Associated with testicular microlithiasis, a premalignant condition linked to gonadal GCT. Patient showed symptomatic improvement with cisplatin-based chemotherapy.

title: Incidence and survival of rare female genital tract cancers in Europe: The EUROCARE-6 study.
title_ja: ヨーロッパにおける稀な女性生殖器癌の発症率と生存率：EUROCARE-6研究
summary_ja: ヨーロッパの100がん登録データを用いた大規模疫学研究EUROCARE-6。25の稀な女性生殖器癌の発症率と生存率を報告。卵巣の未熟奇形腫と妊娠性絨毛癌の生存率が特に改善。診療体制の充実と診断能の向上が生存改善に貢献。
summary_en: Large European epidemiological study (EUROCARE-6) examining incidence and survival of 25 rare female genital tract cancers. Includes malignant/immature teratomas of ovary and placental choriocarcinoma. Reports improving survival for immature teratomas and gestational choriocarcinoma over 2001-2013.

title: Development of an Ultrasound-Based Clinical-Radiomic Nomogram for Predicting Histologic Subtypes in Focal Testicular Tumors.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍の組織亜型予測のための超音波検査ベースの臨床放射線学的ノモグラム開発
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の組織亜型を術前に予測する超音波検査ベースの臨床放射線学的ノモグラムを開発。精巣胚細胞腫瘍とセミノーマを非セミノーマ性腫瘍から高精度(AUC 0.89-0.93)で鑑別でき、非侵襲的診断が可能。
summary_en: Study developing ultrasound-based clinical-radiomic nomogram to preoperatively predict histologic subtypes of testicular tumors. Distinguishes testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs) including seminomas from non-seminomatous tumors with high AUC values (0.89-0.93), enabling non-invasive discrimination of GCT subtypes.

title: Anti-N-methyl-d-aspartate Receptor Encephalitis Caused by a Teratoma Arising From the Retroperitoneum.
title_ja: 後腹膜発生奇形腫が原因の抗NMDA受容体脳炎
summary_ja: 27歳女性が後腹膜発生の性腺外奇形腫による抗NMDA受容体脳炎を発症。抗NMDA受容体脳炎患者の46%で腫瘍が認められ、94%が卵巣奇形腫だが、本症例は性腺外奇形腫であった。血漿交換で臨床症状が著明に改善。
summary_en: Case report of 27-year-old woman with anti-NMDAR encephalitis caused by extragonadal teratoma from retroperitoneum. Highlights importance of systemic search for extra-ovarian teratomas in anti-NMDAR encephalitis patients, where 46% of female cases have associated tumors.

title: Transverse testicular ectopia with persistent müllerian duct syndrome: a case report.
title_ja: 永続性ミューラー管遺残症候群を伴う横方向精巣異所症:症例報告
summary_ja: 両精巣が同じ陰嚢内にある横方向精巣異位と永続性ミューラー管症候群を伴う50歳男性の症例。異所性右精巣内にseminomaが認められ、精巣descent解剖学の理解に貢献。
summary_en: Case of 50-year-old with transverse testicular ectopia and persistent Müllerian duct syndrome. Histopathology revealed seminoma within ectopic right testis. Case illustrates rare testicular GCT presentation and contributes to understanding of testicular descent anatomy and GCT risk in cryptorchidism.

title: A Complex Case of Testicular Choriocarcinoma in Cryptorchidism and Choriocarcinoma Syndrome: Clinical and Treatment Insights.
title_ja: 停留精巣における精巣絨毛癌と絨毛癌症候群の複雑症例：臨床的および治療的知見
summary_ja: 52歳男性で未治療の停留精巣から発生した精巣絨毛癌症例。β-hCGが236,335 IU/Lと著明に上昇し、複数臓器への転移を認めた。新補助化学療法と除精巣術・補助化学療法を施行したが、脳転移により診断後10ヶ月で死亡。
summary_en: Case report of 52-year-old with untreated cryptorchidism and testicular choriocarcinoma, a rare non-seminomatous germ cell tumor (<1% of testicular malignancies). Markedly elevated β-hCG with metastases to multiple organs. Despite neoadjuvant chemotherapy and surgery, patient developed brain metastases and died.

title: Experience of nine south eastern European transplant centers with testicular cancer in kidney transplant recipients.
title_ja: 腎移植受者における精巣がんについての南東ヨーロッパ9つの移植センターの経験
summary_ja: ヨーロッパ9施設における腎移植受信者の精巣がん（seminomaおよび non-seminoma GCT）に関する多施設研究。先行悪性腫瘍の既往または家族歴がリスク因子として報告された6症例。早期に検出されて精巣摘除術で優れた予後。
summary_en: Multicenter study of testicular cancer (seminoma and non-seminoma GCTs) in kidney transplant recipients across 9 European centers. Reports 6 cases (0.14% incidence) with history of prior malignancy or family history as risk factors. Excellent outcomes when detected early with orchiectomy.

title: BRD9 inhibition as potential treatment option for testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の潜在的治療選択肢としてのBRD9阻害
summary_ja: 化学療法耐性精巣germ cell tumor の代替治療として BRD9 阻害を検討する研究。BRD9阻害剤は多能性マーカーのダウンレギュレーションと上皮分化促進を伴いながらアポトーシスとG1期停止を誘導。多能性からの脱出を示唆。
summary_en: Study investigating BRD9 inhibition as alternative treatment for therapy-resistant testicular germ cell tumors. BRD9 inhibitor induces apoptosis and G1-phase arrest while downregulating pluripotency markers and promoting epithelial differentiation, suggesting exit from pluripotency as potential GCT response mechanism.

title: Successful Treatment of Anti-N-Methyl-D-Aspartate Receptor Encephalitis With Bilateral Ovarian Teratomas Through Three Surgeries Without Loss of Fertility.
title_ja: 妊孕性温存により3回の手術で治療した両側卵巣奇形腫を伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎症例
summary_ja: 両側卵巣奇形腫と抗NMDA受容体脳炎の28歳女性が3回の保存的手術と免疫療法で治療。卵管卵巣摘除術と嚢胞摘出術により妊孕性を温存し、2年後に出産達成。
summary_en: Case of 28-year-old woman with bilateral ovarian teratomas and anti-NMDAR encephalitis. Underwent three conservative surgeries (cystectomies) preserving fertility rather than oophorectomy. Successfully treated with immunotherapy and surgical management, achieving pregnancy and live birth.

title: Retroperitoneal Mass, Abdominal Pain, and Bilateral Hydronephrosis Caused by Testicular Seminoma: A Case Report and Review of the Literature.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマによる後腹膜腫瘤、腹痛および両側水腎症:症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節転移による両側水腎症を伴う腹痛と精巣腫大で発症した精巣seminoma の症例報告。精巣seminoma の多様な臨床的プレゼンテーションをレビューし、多彩な臨床症状の認識の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of 44-year-old with testicular seminoma presenting with abdominal pain, testicular swelling, and bilateral hydronephrosis from retroperitoneal lymph node metastases. Reviews various presentations of testicular seminoma and importance of recognizing varied clinical manifestations.

title: Pediatric Spine Ultrasound: Comprehensive Review and Systematic Approach.
title_ja: 小児脊椎超音波:包括的レビューと体系的アプローチ
summary_ja: 小児脊椎超音波の総合的レビュー。先天性腫瘍として仙骨尾骨teratoma（germ cell tumor）を含む適応症をカバー。小児脊椎病態、特にGCTの評価と管理のための詳細な超音波画像診断と超音波ガイド法を提供。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of pediatric spine ultrasound techniques and interpretation. Covers indications including congenital tumors like sacrococcygeal teratomas (germ cell tumors). Provides detailed sonographic anatomy and ultrasound-guided approaches for evaluating and managing pediatric spinal pathology including GCTs.

title: Appraising the causal role of cathepsins in genitourinary carcinoma: a two-sample mendelian randomization and prospective study based on 36,225 individuals.
title_ja: 生殖泌尿器系癌におけるカテプシンの因果的役割の評価:36,225人の個人に基づいた2標本メンデリアンランダム化と前向き研究
summary_ja: 血清カテプシンレベルと泌尿生殖器がんの因果関連性をメンデルランダム化法で調査。カテプシンBが精巣非セミノーマと正の関連を示す。UK Biobankで検証。
summary_en: This Mendelian randomization study investigates causal associations between serum cathepsin levels and genitourinary carcinomas. Cathepsin B is positively associated with testicular non-seminoma, while cathepsin L2 shows protective effects. Findings were validated using UK Biobank data of 36,225 individuals.

title: Oncologic and fertility outcome in patients with advanced stage ovarian immature teratomas.
title_ja: 進行期卵巣未熟奇形腫患者における腫瘍学的および妊孕性転帰
summary_ja: 進行期卵巣未熟奇形腫患者17例の後方視的研究。76.5%が妊孕性温存手術を、82%が補助化学療法を施行。中央値237ヶ月のフォローアップで全例無病生存、FSS例の46%が妊娠達成。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 17 patients with advanced-stage ovarian immature teratomas. Most underwent fertility-sparing surgery with adjuvant chemotherapy. Despite advanced disease, all patients survived without evidence of disease. Fertility-sparing surgery proved safe and effective, with 46% achieving pregnancy.

title: Cornual Epithelioid Trophoblastic Tumor: A Report of a Rare Case and Literature Review.
title_ja: 角部類上皮栄養膜腫瘍：稀な症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 38歳サウジアラビア女性の角部子宮外妊娠が類上皮栄養膜腫瘍と診断。メトトレキサート治療後も高β-hCGが続いたため、外科的切除と多剤化学療法で正常化達成。
summary_en: Case report of epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT), a rare form of gestational trophoblastic neoplasm, from cornual ectopic pregnancy. Despite initial methotrexate treatment, the patient required surgical intervention and multi-agent chemotherapy for β-hCG normalization, achieving successful treatment.

title: Malignant transformation of an ovarian mature teratoma diagnosed 17 years ago: a case report and literature review of treatment with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
title_ja: 17年前に診断された卵巣成熟奇形腫の悪性転化：症例報告と免疫チェックポイント阻害薬による治療の文献レビュー
summary_ja: 17年前診断の卵巣成熟奇形腫が悪性転化し扁平上皮癌となった69歳女性。手術、パクリタキセル・カルボプラチン化学療法、ニラパリブ維持療法、ペムブロリズマブ免疫療法で治療され部分奏効達成。
summary_en: Case report of 69-year-old woman whose ovarian mature teratoma underwent malignant transformation to squamous cell carcinoma after 17 years. Treatment included surgery, chemotherapy (paclitaxel/carboplatin), niraparib, and pembrolizumab immunotherapy, demonstrating partial response.

title: Cytoreductive surgery combined with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy for Pseudomyxoma peritonei originating from ovarian teratomas: A single-center case series and literature review.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫由来の腹膜偽粘液腫に対する減量手術と腹腔内温熱化学療法の併用：単一施設症例集積と文献レビュー
journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫由来腹膜偽粘液腫患者4例を減量手術と腹腔内温熱化学療法で治療した後方視的研究。最適減量未達成だが、高グレード例を除き良好な術後転帰を示した。
summary_en: Retrospective study of four patients with pseudomyxoma peritonei originating from ovarian mature teratomas treated with cytoreductive surgery and hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy. All underwent CRS with HIPEC; high-grade PMP showed poorer prognosis. CRS with HIPEC is safe and effective for this complication.

title: Association of testicular calcifications and intracranial germinoma: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 精巣石灰化と頭蓋内胚腫の関連：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 思春期後男性の大脳基底核の頭蓋内胚腫が頭痛と四肢脱力で発見された。陰嚢超音波で両精巣の精巣微小石灰化が認められ、頭蓋内胚腫と精巣病変の関連性について考察された。
summary_en: Case report of adolescent male with intracranial seminoma at basal ganglia presenting with headache and limb weakness. Scrotal ultrasound revealed bilateral testicular microlithiasis. Discusses possible links between testicular lesions and extragonadal seminoma development.

title: SMARCB1-deficient poorly differentiated testicular carcinoma: a case report.
title_ja: SMARCB1欠損低分化精巣癌:症例報告
summary_ja: SMARCB1欠損の未分化精巣癌の初報告例。多剤治療にも関わらず予後不良。
summary_en: Case report of 36-year-old male with SMARCB1/INI1-deficient poorly differentiated testicular carcinoma showing mixed embryonal carcinoma or seminoma features. Despite multimodal therapy including chemotherapy, radiotherapy, and immunotherapy, patient died 11 months post-surgery.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma in a 10-year-old-female: a rare case report from Nepal.
title_ja: 10歳女児の仙尾部奇形腫:ネパールからの稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 10歳女児の仙尾骨部奇形腫症例。進行性仙骨部腫脹で発症。手術で治癒。
summary_en: Case report of 10-year-old girl with sacrococcygeal teratoma presenting with progressive sacral swelling, fever, pain, and discharge for 2 weeks. MRI confirmed complex infra-coccygeal mass. Surgical resection performed with good outcome, highlighting importance of early diagnosis.

title: Incidental Discovery of Persistent Müllerian Duct Syndrome in a Male With Bilateral Cryptorchidism and a Testicular Germ Cell Tumor: A Rare Case Report.
title_ja: 両側停留精巣および精巣胚細胞腫瘍を有する男性における遺残ミュラー管症候群の偶然発見：稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 24歳男性で両側停留精巣および左精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍が確認された。偶然に遺残ミュラー管症候群が発見され、術後腫瘍マーカー正常化で6ヶ月後に再発なし。
summary_en: Case report of 24-year-old male with bilateral cryptorchidism and mixed germ cell tumor (yolk sac tumor, seminoma, teratoma) of left testis. Incidental finding of persistent Müllerian duct syndrome. Post-operative tumor markers normalized within one month with no recurrence at six-month follow-up.

title: Pathological complete response with cocktail chemotherapy in mediastinal seminoma.
title_ja: 縦隔セミノーマにおけるカクテル化学療法による病理学的完全奏効
summary_ja: 40代男性の大型前縦隔セミノーマで左迷走神経麻痺を伴う症例。導入療法エトポシド/シスプラチン後の交互化学療法で病理学的完全奏効と完全切除を達成した。
summary_en: Case report of man in his 40s with large anterior mediastinal seminoma causing phrenic nerve involvement. Treated with induction etoposide/cisplatin followed by alternating PEB regimen, achieving pathological complete response after chemotherapy and complete surgical resection.

title: Single-Port Robot-Assisted Post-Chemotherapy Unilateral Retroperitoneal Lymph Node Dissection: Feasibility and Surgical Considerations.
title_ja: 単一ポートロボット支援化学療法後一側後腹膜リンパ節郭清：実行可能性と外科的考慮事項
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者に対する単一ポートロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清の初例。病理検査で未熟奇形腫とリンパ節炎症が確認され、6ヶ月後に無病生存を達成した。
summary_en: First European case report of single-port robotic-assisted RPLND in 41-year-old with non-seminomatous testicular GCT. Pathology revealed immature teratoma and benign lymph nodes. Patient achieved disease-free status at six months with normal tumor markers and stable renal function.

title: Paraneoplastic Leucine Zipper 4 IgG Associated Motor-Predominant Polyradiculoneuropathy.
title_ja: 傍腫瘍症候群Leucine Zipper 4 IgG関連運動優位多根神経根炎
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに関連するLUZP4-IgG関連傍腫瘍性神経症候群。化学療法後も免疫療法が必要で改善。
summary_en: Case report of 51-year-old with testicular seminoma and LUZP4-IgG seropositivity presenting with motor-predominant polyradiculoneuropathy. Despite orchiectomy and chemotherapy, patient required aggressive immunotherapy with cyclophosphamide, eventually showing significant improvement in hand strength.

title: Standard-Dose Versus High-Dose Cisplatin for Intermediate/Poor-Risk Extracranial Malignant Germ Cell Tumors: Re-Analysis of Pediatric Oncology Group 9049 and Children's Cancer Group 8882 Trial Using Updated MaGIC Risk Stratification.
title_ja: 中間/低リスク頭蓋外悪性胚細胞腫瘍に対する標準用量対高用量シスプラチン:更新MaGICリスク分類を用いたPOG9049およびCCG8882試験の再解析
summary_ja: GCT治療の臨床試験の再解析。高用量と標準用量シスプラチンの効果に差なし。
summary_en: Re-analysis of POG9049/CCG8882 trial examining high-dose versus standard-dose cisplatin-based chemotherapy for intermediate/poor-risk extracranial GCTs using updated MaGIC stratification. No significant difference in 5-year event-free or overall survival between treatment groups.

title: Pembrolizumab and olaparib in a cisplatin-refractory testicular cancer patient with a high TMB: first case report.
title_ja: シスプラチン耐性精巣がん患者におけるペムブロリズマブとオラパリブ:最初の症例報告
summary_ja: シスプラチン耐性の性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者にペムブロリズマブとオラパリブで治療した初の症例報告。高PD-L1発現と高腫瘍遺伝子変異負荷に基づいて治療が選択された。ペムブロリズマブ開始4週以内にβ-hCGの顕著な低下が見られたが、その後再び増加し、免疫関連肺炎により患者は死亡した。
summary_en: First case report of cisplatin-refractory extragonadal non-seminomatous GCT (choriocarcinoma) treated with pembrolizumab and olaparib based on high PD-L1 expression and tumor mutational burden. Despite initial β-hCG decrease, patient developed immune-related pneumonitis with fatal outcome.

title: Extragonadal immature teratoma of the uterus.
title_ja: 子宮の性腺外未熟奇形腫
summary_ja: 膣出血で来院した27歳未産婦女性における子宮性腺外未熟奇形腫症例報告。卵巣保存を伴う全腹腔鏡下子宮摘出術および補助化学療法レジメン(BEP)で治療。胚細胞腫瘍に対する生殖保存的治療アプローチの成功例を示した。
summary_en: Case report of 27-year-old nulliparous woman with extragonadal immature teratoma of uterus presenting with vaginal bleeding. Treated with total laparoscopic hysterectomy with ovarian preservation and adjuvant BEP chemotherapy. Demonstrates successful fertility-sparing approach for extragonadal GCT.

title: Oxidative stress markers 8-OHdG, Trx-1, and Prx6 are expressed in seminoma and are connected to TXNDC2, 3, and 6 expression levels.
title_ja: セミノーマにおける酸化ストレスマーカー8-OHdG、Trx-1、およびPrx6の発現とTXNDC2、3、6発現レベルとの関連
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ25例の酸化ストレスマーカー（8-OHdG、Trx-1、Prx6）とチオレドキシンレベルを検討した免疫組織化学研究。セミノーマは正常精巣と異なるマーカー発現パターンを示した。Trx-1とTXNDC6過剰発現がセミノーマ生物学に関連の可能性。
summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of 25 testicular seminomas examining oxidative stress markers (8-OHdG, Trx-1, Prx6) and thioredoxin levels. Found distinct expression patterns in seminomas compared to normal testis. Trx-1 and TXNDC6 overexpression may be relevant to seminoma biology.

title: Papillary thyroid carcinoma and strumal carcinoid transformations of a mature cystic teratoma with NRAS codon 61 mutation: A case report.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における乳頭状甲状腺癌と甲状腺ストルマカルチノイドの同時悪性転化の症例報告
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における乳頭状甲状腺癌と甲状腺ストルマカルチノイドの同時悪性転化の稀な症例。次世代シーケンシング検査で両悪性成分にNRAS codon 61変異が認められた。単一奇形腫での両悪性腫瘍の共存は世界で6例目。
summary_en: Case report of mature cystic teratoma with simultaneous papillary thyroid carcinoma and strumal carcinoid transformation. NGS revealed NRAS codon 61 mutations in both malignant components. This is only sixth reported case of coexisting these two malignancies in single teratoma.

title: A case of neonatal gastric teratoma complicated with occult gastrointestinal hemorrhage misdiagnosed as lymphangioma.
title_ja: リンパ管腫と誤診された潜在性消化管出血を伴う新生児胃奇形腫の症例
summary_ja: 潜在性消化管出血による重度の貧血を呈した新生児男児の胃未熟奇形腫症例。リンパ管腫と誤診されたが、石灰化と脂肪を含む大きな嚢胞固形腫瘤を確認。外科的切除を施行し、病理診断は1級未熟奇形腫。術後発達は良好で合併症なし。
summary_en: Case report of 28-day-old boy with neonatal gastric immature teratoma presenting with anemia from occult gastrointestinal hemorrhage. Large cystic-solid mass contained calcifications and fat. Surgical resection performed; pathology confirmed grade 1 immature teratoma. Post-operative development normal.

title: Research Progress in Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors for Relapsed and Refractory Malignant Gonadal Germ Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 再発・治療抵抗性の悪性性腺胚細胞腫瘍に対する免疫チェックポイント阻害薬の研究進展
journal: Zhongguo Yi Xue Ke Xue Yuan Xue Bao
summary_ja: 再発・治療抵抗性性腺胚細胞腫瘍における免疫チェックポイント阻害薬の免疫機構および臨床有効性をまとめたレビュー。症例報告と臨床試験を検討し、免疫療法の有効性を評価し、臨床実践の参考資料を提供する。
summary_en: Review article summarizing immune mechanisms and clinical efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in relapsed and refractory gonadal germ cell tumors. Examines case reports and clinical trials to assess effectiveness of immunotherapy, providing reference for future clinical practice.

title: Multidisciplinary Management of an Anterior Skull Base Teratoma in a Neonate.
title_ja: 新生児の頭蓋前底部奇形腫の学際的管理
summary_ja: 新生児女児が鼻咽頭へ延伸した稀な成熟頭蓋前底部奇形腫の症例。胎児手術による準備、経鼻腔内切除、および2段階の形成再建手術を施行。3年のフォローアップで再発なく神経学的欠損も認めず、鼻唇領域の最適な美容的転帰を達成。
summary_en: Case report of neonatal girl with rare mature skull base teratoma extending into nasopharynx. Managed with fetal surgery preparation, endoscopic resection, and 2-stage plastic reconstruction. Three-year follow-up shows no recurrence and optimal cosmetic outcome without neurological deficits.

title: A Breathtaking Case of Chemotherapy-Induced Pneumonitis.
title_ja: 化学療法誘発性肺炎の症例報告
summary_ja: 転移性セミノーマ患者において胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法レジメンに用いられるエトポシド誘発性肺炎の稀な症例を報告。化学療法剤による肺毒性の診断は重要であり、化学療法中の急性呼吸不全を呈した患者では本疾患を鑑別診断に含めることの重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of etoposide-induced pneumonitis in metastatic seminoma patient. Documents rare pulmonary toxicity from chemotherapy agent used in germ cell tumor treatment, highlighting diagnostic importance during acute respiratory failure.

title: Oncologic outcomes of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection following first-line chemotherapy for metastatic non-seminomatous germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する一次化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清の腫瘍学的転帰
summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清に関する大規模研究。病理学的予後、生存率を評価し、残存腫瘍サイズと原発腫瘍組織型が外科手術適応判定の予測因子であることを示した。
summary_en: Large-scale study of post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in metastatic NSGCT. Evaluated pathologic outcomes, survival rates, and identified predictive factors including residual mass size and primary tumor histology for surgical decision-making.

title: Case Report: Prepubertal-type testicular teratoma with local metastasis in a postpubertal patient.
title_ja: 症例報告：思春期後患者における思春期前型精巣奇形腫の局所転移
summary_ja: 思春期後男性における転移性精巣成熟奇形腫の初報告。12p異常とGCNISを欠く成熟奇形腫が転移性を有する可能性があり、従来の分類パラダイムに反することを示唆している。
summary_en: First case report of metastatic mature testicular teratoma in postpubertal patient. Demonstrates that pure mature teratomas lacking chromosomal 12p abnormalities and GCNIS may possess metastatic potential, contrary to current classification paradigms.

title: Diagnostic value of magnetic resonance imaging for malignant ovarian tumors mis-subclassified by the ultrasound-based ADNEX model.
title_ja: 超音波ベースADNEXモデルで誤分類された悪性卵巣腫瘍に対する磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)の診断価値
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍を含む卵巣悪性腫瘍のMRI診断研究。卵黄嚢腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマ、未熟奇形腫など多様な組織型を対象に、超音波ベースのADNEXモデルで誤分類された症例におけるMRI画像特徴を分析し、診断精度の向上を検討した。
summary_en: MRI diagnostic study of ovarian malignancies including germ cell tumors (GCT, YST, dysgerminoma, immature teratoma). Analyzed imaging features in cases misclassified by ultrasound ADNEX model to improve diagnostic accuracy.
